g.text: Each timer wake-up starts a new application boot.
This diagram shows the regular cycle without an OTA request.
Deep sleep is entered only if
subscribe and poll for OTA requests (up to 2 s)
and MqttOtaRequestReader. OTA maintenance is omitted here
and will be covered in a separate OTA sequence diagram.
Does not trigger another hardware measurement.
Validation results are currently ignored by the publishing logic.
then starts deep sleep if configuration succeeds.
